contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' ($835.72) on the p4 Summary Page — the PROMOTED per-period cell — which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 835.72' AND its printed 'Total Contributions Received $ 835.72 (Sum of all Schedule A Pages in this report)'. Three printed statements of the same figure, all agreeing.
contributions.detail: The 11 Schedule A rows sum to 53.00 + 48.95 + 100.00 + 200.00 + 25.00 + 98.00 + 18.72 + 94.80 + 47.25 + 50.00 + 100.00 = 835.72 exactly. That equals the schedule's printed page subtotal (835.72), its printed total (835.72), and the cover's promoted per-period Box B (835.72). Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' also prints $835.72 and is retained as the CUMULATIVE figure, never summed as an increment — here period and year-to-date happen to coincide because Box A 'Balance at Beginning of Reporting Period' is the filer's dash-zero glyph '-0-' (read 0 under the zero-glyph ruling, and transcribed verbatim by the cover tranche). The page's own identities close independently and corroborate the read: Box F 'Subtotal before Expenditures (Box A + Box B)' prints $835.72 = 0 + 835.72, and Box G 'Balance at Close of Reporting Period (Box F - Box D)' prints -$388.88 = 835.72 - 1224.60 exactly, sign kept.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' ($1224.60) on the p4 Summary Page — the PROMOTED per-period cell — which is also Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 1224.60' AND its printed 'Total Expenditures Made $ 1224.60 (Sum of all Schedule B Pages in this report)'.
expenditures.detail: The 7 Schedule B rows sum to 33.78 + 43.98 + 209.14 + 881.51 + 2.03 + 10.18 + 43.98 = 1224.60 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = Box D. Box E 'Expenditures Made Year to Date' prints $1224.60 and is retained as cumulative, never summed as an increment. The negative closing balance Box G (-$388.88 = Box F 835.72 - Box D 1224.60) is a third independent check on this figure and it closes to the cent.

itemized.in_kind_convention: MONETARY-ONLY, and it was tested rather than assumed. This is the NEWER 2022 blank and BOTH schedules carry an IN-KIND CHECKBOX column, so the two conventions are genuinely distinguishable here. Per §J1 the Amount and In-Kind cells were cropped TOGETHER as one block on each schedule (a86fa955_p2_amt_ink.png at 700 dpi covering all 11 used contribution rows, a86fa955_p3_amt_ink.png covering all 7 used expenditure rows) so that the half-row-high checkbox offset could not misassign a tick: EVERY In-Kind checkbox on both pages is EMPTY. With no in-kind marked anywhere, monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind give the identical sums (835.72 and 1224.60) and both close, and monetary-only is the correct description of what the document states. No convention was carried in from any other filing.
itemized.escalation_note: Four escalations, all at 700-900 dpi tight crops, all corroborating the full-page read and none changing a value. (1) Amount+In-Kind block crops on both schedules (see in_kind_convention) rendered every amount in order and every checkbox empty. (2) Left-column crops of Schedule A at 700 dpi (a86fa955_p2_left_top.png rows 1-6, a86fa955_p2_left_bot.png rows 7-11) were the FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: they render the Date column holding dates, 'Name of Contributor' holding names, and 'City and State' holding city+state pairs, so the columns are assignable BY CONTENT and not merely by position, and they confirmed row 9 (David Keller) has a genuinely EMPTY City and State cell. (3) The row-1/row-11 and row-1/row-7 amount-cell proofs listed in each frame's measure_note. (4) Full-width row-strip crops at 400 dpi (a86fa955_p2_strip.png, a86fa955_p3_strip.png) used to locate the printed vertical rules for the `cells` provenance bands.

itemized.notes: 2022 cycle, `modern_boxAF`, and it is **the NEWER UNVERSIONED 2022 BLANK** of §J1 — all four tells confirmed on the pages: SIX report types on the cover (including 'End-of-Year Report'), Schedule A's third column headed **'City and State'** (not 'Address and Zip Code') with a fifth **IN-KIND checkbox** column, the close box **LETTERED 'G'**, and the cover's bottom-right box headed **'Date of Filing'** with **no Page field anywhere** — so this filing is UNFOLIATED and page ordinals carry no filer evidence at all. No 'v.' revision string is printed. All 4 pages rot 0 (pdfinfo -f 1 -l 4); no rotation handling needed. Creator 'Canon iR-ADV C7770 PDF' / Producer 'Adobe PSL 1.3e for Canon', Form: none — a scan of a typed (machine-set) form, crisp, at about -1.4 to -1.5 deg skew with the whole page image reduced within the sheet. PAGE STRUCTURE, classified from each page's own printed header and NOT from position: p1 COVER; p2 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received'; p3 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made'; p4 'Summary Page'. **NO CHECKLIST DECOY IS BOUND IN THIS FILING** — the four pages are all report pages and p4 carries real dollar figures in every box. THE SUMMARY PAGE IS LAST here, which is the usual place for this variant, but it was located by its printed heading and its lettered boxes, never by the ordinal. PAGE-FACE IDENTITY: candidate 'Candace Jacobson'; Office box prints 'Utah County Clerk'; the report-type radio FILLED is 'Seven days preceding the General Election'; the amendment question is answered — 'No' is ticked; the signature is handwritten and present in the clear; the Date box is handwritten '10/31/2022' and the Date of Filing box prints '10/31/2022', while all three inner sheets print 'Date of Report 10/31/2022'. index.csv's channel label agrees on candidate and office; its period label 'General' is a reasonable rendering of the page's 'Seven days preceding the General Election' — both recorded, neither adjudicated. Note the FILENAME says 11.1.22 and the PDF's CreationDate is Nov 1 2022, one day after the filing date the page itself prints: the filename records when the county scanned it, not when it was filed. **NO REDACTION ANYWHERE**, judged per cell from the pages: the filename carries no `_Redacted` suffix and, consistently, the candidate's own address block, phone, email and signature are all published in the clear, and every donor's City and State cell is either filled or blank by the filer's own hand. The candidate's street address is deliberately NOT carried into this record (privacy is applied at read time regardless of what the page publishes), and no donor street address exists to carry — this blank's third column asks only for CITY AND STATE, the §J1 case where the privacy reduction is a no-op. Box A is the filer's DASH-ZERO glyph '-0-', which the zero-glyph ruling reads as 0 with the glyph preserved; Box G is a genuine NEGATIVE, printed '-$388.88', and the sign is load-bearing (it is exactly Box F minus Box D). Both sides close exactly on their promoted per-period cells with three agreeing printed statements each; nothing was nudged, no delta arose, and no figure was taken from any other document.
